analyzed_vuln.description: The root cause is inconsistent CFG/SSA edge updates during jump simplification in zend_dfa_optimize_jmps(). The pass rewrites/removes branch opcodes (e.g., JMPZ/JMPNZ/JMP_SET/COALESCE/JMP_NULL/SWITCH/MATCH -> NOP or JMP) and mutates successors via take_successor_* / take_successor_ex, then compresses/unlinks blocks. For this PoV, these transformations leave CFG predecessor/successor metadata inconsistent (e.g., missing reciprocal predecessor entry), which is later detected by ssa_verify_integrity() and triggers the assert at ssa_integrity.c:401.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger requires optimizer DFA pass with SSA integrity checks enabled (ZEND_DEBUG_DFA path) on a malformed/complex script that causes constant-folding and branch/jump canonicalization in zend_dfa_optimize_jmps(). Input from fuzzer_do_request_from_buffer is compiled by opcache, then zend_dfa_optimize_op_array() runs; when jump optimization removes/retargets edges and block compression/unlinking occurs in a specific pattern, CFG bookkeeping becomes invalid, and subsequent ssa_verify_integrity() aborts.
